column1: Okay, so last time we were studying the group of motions of R^n,   the group G of motions M from R^n to R^n which preserve the distance function d from v to w,
column2: 好的，上次我们研究了 R^n 的刚体运动群， 即由 R^n 到 R^n 保持两点 v 到 w 之间距离函数 d 的运动 M 所构成的群 G，

column1: which is absolute value |v - w|, so it's all set-theoretic maps from R^n to R^n which preserve the distance between the two points, so this should be equal to d of M(v), M(w).
column2: 该距离就是绝对值（范数）|v - w|；它是所有保持两点间距离的 R^n 到 R^n 的集合论映射，所以这应当等于 d(M(v), M(w))。

column1: And we observed that there's a subgroup of this isomorphic to R^n itself under addition of translations,   and those are things if you have a vector b in R^n and you just take an arbitrary vector v to v + b, so that translates vectors.
column2: 我们还观察到它包含一个同构于加法群 R^n 本身的平移子群， 也就是如果你在 R^n 中有一个向量 b，你把任意向量 v 映射到 v + b，这就是对向量进行平移。

column1: And that clearly preserves the distance because the distance only depends on the distance—the difference between two vectors, so the difference is the same if you translate.
column2: 这显然保持距离，因为两点间的距离只取决于距离——即两个向量之差，而平移后两向量之差保持不变。

column1: Now I claim that any element in G can be written uniquely as a translation, an element in this subgroup, times an element in the subgroup I'll call G_0, where these are the motions that preserve the origin.
column2: 现在我断言，G 中的任意元素都可以唯一地写成一个平移（该子群中的元素），乘以一个来自我记作 G_0 的子群中的元素，其中 G_0 是保持原点不动的运动。

column1: And that's clear, because if I have an arbitrary transformation, then it takes the origin somewhere, i.e., M of 0 is equal to some b.
column2: 这很显然，因为如果我有一个任意变换，它把原点映到某个位置，即 M(0) 等于某个向量 b。

column1: So if I just compose M with the translation—let's see, yeah, M composed with the translation, let's call this translation T_b or something, T_{-b} of M of 0 is now equal to 0, so this is an element in G_0, and it's a translation times M.
column2: 那么如果我把 M 与平移复合——看看，对，M 与平移复合，不妨把这个平移记作 T_b 或别的，T_{-b}(M(0)) 现在就等于 0 了，所以这是 G_0 中的一个元素，并且它是一个平移乘以 M。

column1: So multiplying by T_b inverse, I get M as—get the arbitrary element as a translation times something in G_0. And these two groups have no intersection because no translation preserves 0.
column2: 因此两边乘以 T_b^{-1}，我就把任意元素 M 写成了一个平移乘上 G_0 中的某个元素。并且这两个群没有非平凡交集，因为除恒等映射外没有平移能保原点。

column1: So everything is uniquely written as a translation times something fixing 0.
column2: 所以每个元素都唯一地写成平移乘以保持 0 不动的变换。

column1: And the last time I claimed was that G_0 was isomorphic to O(n), the group of orthogonal transformations.
column2: 上次我还断言 G_0同构于 O(n)，即正交变换群。

column1: Clearly this is contained in G_0, because these are linear maps so they preserve 0; they preserve the inner product so they preserve the distance, right, because this is just the inner product of v - w with v - w, the square root of it.
column2: 这显然包含在 G_0 中，因为正交变换是线性映射所以保持 0；而且它们保持内积，从而保持距离，对吧，因为距离正是 v - w 与自身内积的平方根。

column1: So anything that preserves the inner product preserves the distance, and so this is certainly contained in G_0. And the trick is to show it's all of G_0.
column2: 所以任何保持内积的变换都保持距离，因而这必然包含在 G_0 中。关键在于证明它就是整个 G_0。

column1: And the trick last time I showed that if it preserved the distance it also preserves the inner product, but we don't know that it's linear.
column2: 并且上次的关键技巧是：如果它保持距离，它也保持内积；但我们还不知道它是线性的。

column1: I have to prove to you that it's linear, so I'm now going to prove that this is an isomorphism in the following way. Take an element in G_0, so M in G_0. The claim is that <M(v), M(w)> is equal to <v, w>. This is what we proved last time, that it preserves the inner product. And the reason is (w) is equal to <v, w>.
column2: 我必须向大家证明它是线性的，所以我现在用以下方式证明这是一个同构。取 G_0 中的一个元素 M，断言是 <M(v), M(w)> = <v, w>。这就是我们上次证明的内容：它保持内积，原因在于(w) 等于 <v, w>。

column1: This is what we proved last time, that it preserves the inner product, and the reason is because you have the formula that d(v, w)^2 is equal to d(v, 0)^2 + d(w, 0)^2 minus two times the inner product.
column2: 这就是我们上次证明的内容：它保持内积，原因在于因为你有公式：d(v, w)^2 等于 d(v, 0)^2 + d(w, 0)^2 减去两倍的内积。

column1: If you expand this out, you get <v, v> + <w, w> - 2<v, w>, and <v, v> is the distance from v to 0 squared, plus <w, w> which is the distance from w to 0 squared.
column2: 如果你把这个展开，会得到 <v, v> + <w, w> - 2<v, w>，其中 <v, v> 是 v 到 0 的距离平方，加 <w, w>即 w 到 0 的距离平方。

column1: So if you have a group of motions that preserves the origin, it preserves the distance between two points; since it preserves the origin, it preserves the distance of a vector from the origin; it preserves the distance of w from the origin, so it has to preserve this inner product.
column2: 因此如果你有一个保持原点的运动群，它保持两点之间的距离；由于它保持原点，它就保持向量到原点的距离；它保持 w 到原点的距离，所以它必须保持这个内积。

column1: So anything in this subgroup preserves the inner product. Now consider what it does to an orthonormal basis: let e_1 through e_n be the standard basis of R^n. Did we ever get chalk? There it is, okay.
column2: 因此该子群中的任何元素都保持内积。现在考虑它对标准正交基的作用：设 e_1 到 e_n 为R^n 的标准基。我们拿到粉笔了吗？在那儿呢，好的。

column1: Now this has the property that if you take the inner products of the basis vectors with themselves you get 1, and you take the inner product of the basis vectors with another basis vector you get 0.
column2: 现在这组基具有如下性质：如果你取这些基向量与自身的内积得到 1，取基向量与另一个不同基向量的内积得到 0。

column1: Then M(e_1), M(e_2), ..., M(e_n) is another orthonormal basis, right, because this transformation M, which is in G_0, preserves the inner product, and therefore the lengths of these vectors are 1 and they are orthogonal to each other.
column2: 那么 M(e_1), M(e_2), ..., M(e_n)是另一组标准正交基，对吧，因为 G_0 中的这个变换 M 保持内积，所以这些向量的长度都是 1，并且它们彼此正交。

column1: Now consider the following orthogonal transformation:   let A be the element in O(n)   with column vectors M(e_1), M(e_2), ..., M(e_n). That's an orthogonal transformation, because these column vectors are, we know, orthonormal.
column2: 现在考虑以下正交变换： 设 A 为 O(n) 中的元素， 其列向量为 M(e_1), M(e_2), ..., M(e_n)。这是一个正交变换，因为我们知道这些列向量是标准正交的。

column1: And the fact that the column vectors are orthonormal is exactly the statement that A^T A is the identity matrix, and that's what it means to be an orthogonal transformation.
column2: 而列向量标准正交的事实，恰好说明 A^T A 是单位矩阵，这就是正交变换的定义。

column1: So once I have a collection of orthonormal—an orthonormal basis, and I make the transformation that takes this basis to this basis, that's an orthogonal transformation.
column2: 所以一旦我有一组标准正交基，并构造把这组基映到那组基的变换，那就是一个正交变换。

column1: Sure, I'm showing that any element in G_0 is given by an orthogonal transformation.
column2: 当然，我正在证明 G_0 中的任意元素都由某个正交变换给出。

column1: So I started with an element in G_0, I proved that it preserves the inner product, I apply that element to my standard basis, I get a new orthonormal basis, and now I write down a matrix that takes this basis to this basis—that's an orthogonal transformation.
column2: 所以我从 G_0 中的一个元素出发，证明了它保持内积，我把该元素作用在标准基上，得到一组新的标准正交基，现在我写出一个把原基映到这组新基的矩阵——那是一个正交变换。

column1: The claim is M is equal to A as a transformation of R^n.
column2: 现在的断言是：作为 R^n 上的变换，M 等于 A。

column1: Namely, this—all I've done is constructed an element in the orthogonal group that does the same thing as M to these n different vectors, and now I'm going to show it does the same thing as M to every vector.
column2: 也就是说——我所做的只是构造了正交群中的一个元素，它对这 n 个不同的向量具有与 M 相同的效果；现在我要证明它对每一个向量都具有与 M 相同的效果。

column1: Okay, that's what I'm going to try to prove.   What is M(v)?
column2: 好的，这就是我要证明的。 M(v) 是什么？

column1: Well, M(v) is some vector that looks like—let's call it, sorry, w, has n coordinates (w_1, ..., w_n), and v is the vector (v_1, ..., v_n). Okay, what are the coordinates of M(v)?
column2: M(v) 是某个向量，不妨称它为 w，有 n 个坐标 (w_1, ..., w_n)，而 v 是向量 (v_1, ..., v_n)。好的，M(v) 的坐标是什么？

column1: Well, the way you calculate the coordinates of M(v) is that w_i is the inner product of M(v) with the standard basis vector e_i.
column2: 计算M(v) 坐标的方法是：w_i 是 M(v) 与标准基向量 e_i 的内积。

column1: Okay, now I'm going to do it slightly differently—erase this for a second, but same thing. To show that M is equal to A, consider the motion M composed with A inverse.
column2: 好的，现在我要换一种略有不同的方式——先把这里擦掉一下，但本质一样。为了证明 M 等于 A，考虑运动 M与 A^{-1} 的复合。

column1: Call that motion M'.
column2: 把这个运动记作 M'。

column1: That's a motion of space, preserves distance because M was assumed to preserve distance, wherever it was; it's in G_0, and A is an orthogonal transformation which we know preserves distance, so this thing preserves distance.
column2: 这是空间的一个刚体运动，它保持距离，因为原假设 M 保持距离；它属于 G_0，而 A 是正交变换、我们已知它保持距离，所以这个复合也保持距离。

column1: This is in G_0, and it has the property that M'(e_i) is equal to e_i for all i.
column2: 它属于 G_0，并且具有对所有 i 都有 M'(e_i) = e_i 的性质。

column1: And I want to show M'(v) is equal to v for all v in R^n, i.e., A is equal to M on R^n as a transformation.
column2: 我想证明对 R^n 中的所有 v，都有 M'(v) = v，即作为变换，A 在 R^n 上等于 M。

column1: So I know I've constructed an orthogonal matrix such that when I multiply by its inverse on my transformation, I have a transformation that fixes every element of my orthonormal basis. I want to show it fixes every vector, that's the trick.
column2: 所以我知道我构造了一个正交矩阵，使得当我把它的逆复合到原变换上时，我得到了一个保持标准正交基的每个元素不动的变换。我想证明它保持每一个向量不动，这就是诀窍所在。

column1: Well, what are the coordinates of M'(v)? The i-th coordinate of M'(v) is the inner product of M'(v) with the i-th basis vector.
column2: 那么 M'(v) 的坐标是什么？M'(v) 的第 i 个坐标是 M'(v)与第 i 个基向量的内积。

column1: Now since M'(e_i) is e_i, this is the same thing as the inner product of M'(v) with M'(e_i).
column2: 现在由于 M'(e_i) = e_i，这等价于 M'(v)与 M'(e_i) 的内积。

column1: And since M' is a motion that fixes the origin, this is the same as the inner product of v with e_i, and this is the i-th coordinate of v!
column2: 又因为 M' 是保持原点不动的运动，这与 v与 e_i 的内积相同，而这正是 v 的第 i 个坐标！

column1: So the i-th coordinate of M'(v) is the same as the i-th coordinate of v, which means that M' fixes v. Yeah, where I went— this one here.
column2: 因此 M'(v) 的第 i 个坐标与 v 的第 i 个坐标完全相同，这意味着 M' 保持 v 不动。对，我刚才写到哪里了——就是这里。

column1: So I have a vector v, I'm trying to prove it's fixed by M'.
column2: 我有一个向量 v，我想证明它在 M' 下固定不变。

column1: So it suffices to prove that every component of M'(v) is the same as the component of v. So here's the i-th component, it is this. Now since M' fixes e_i, I can replace it by this.
column2: 所以只需证明M'(v) 的每个分量都与 v 的分量相同。第 i 个分量就是这个。现在因为 M' 保持 e_i 不动，我可以把它替换成这个。

column1: Now I use the fact that M' is a motion which preserves the origin, so it preserves the inner product: it's this, which is v_i, which is the i-th coordinate of v. So that shows that M'(v) is equal to v.
column2: 现在利用 M' 是保持原点的刚体运动这一事实，因此它保持内积：结果就是这个，即 v_i，也就是 v 的第 i 个坐标。这证明了 M'(v) = v。

column1: So let's go over how clever this is: we are given an arbitrary motion that fixes the origin; we construct an orthogonal transformation by a matrix that has the same effect on an orthonormal basis,
column2: 所以让我们来回顾这有多么巧妙：我们给定一个保持原点不动的任意刚体运动；我们通过一个对标准正交基具有相同作用的矩阵构造出一个正交变换，

column1: but we don't know it has the same effect on every vector; and then we show it has the same effect on every vector by recovering the coordinates of the vector via the inner product with our orthogonal basis. Very clever proof!
column2: 但我们一开始不知道它对每个向量都具有相同作用；接着我们通过利用与正交基的内积还原向量坐标，证明了它对每个向量都有相同作用。非常巧妙的证明！

column1: So we now have a complete description of the group of motions. The group of motions now looks like this.
column2: 因此我们现在对刚体运动群有了完整的描述。刚体运动群现在呈现出这样的形态。

column1: And let's write down what the product is too, because now that we know the elements in it—the elements in G_0 we've now identified bijectively with the orthogonal transformations. For every M we associated a matrix A, so this is O(n).
column2: 让我们把群乘法也写下来，因为既然我们知道了其中的元素——G_0 中的元素现在已经与正交变换建立了双射对应。对每个 M 我们都关联了一个矩阵 A，属于 O(n)。

column1: An element M of v—where if we have the pair here, we have (b, A), a translation and an orthogonal matrix A. What M does to v is it takes it to A(v), the orthogonal transformation, plus b.
column2: 元素 M 作用在 v 上——如果我们有这里的有序对 (b, A)，一个平移和一个正交矩阵 A。M 对 v 的作用是把它映到 A(v)，即正交变换，再加上 b。

column1: That's the only way you can get a transformation of n-dimensional space that preserves the distance, slightly more general than the orthogonal group.
column2: 这是在 n 维空间中得到保持距离的变换的唯一方式，比正交群略微更具一般性。

column1: And what happens if we take the product of (b, A) with (b', A')? What does that product look like in this group?
column2: 那么如果我们取 (b, A) 与 (b', A') 的乘积会怎样？在这个群中乘积是什么样子？

column1: Well, if we apply it to a vector v, this is (b, A) applied to the vector A'(v) + b', because that's what this does to the vector v.
column2: 如果我们把它作用于向量 v，这就是 (b, A) 作用于向量 A'(v) + b'，因为这正是后者对向量 v 所做的。

column1: And now let's figure out what this does: first we apply the orthogonal transformation to this vector, that becomes A(A'(v) + b'). This is a new vector: we apply the orthogonal transformation to it, and then we translate by b.
column2: 现在我们算算它的效果：首先我们把正交变换作用在这个向量上，变成 A(A'(v) + b')。这是一个新向量：我们对其施加正交变换，然后平移 b。

column1: And if we gather up terms, we find the product of A A' as an element in the orthogonal group applied to v, plus translation by the vector A(b') + b.
column2: 如果合并同类项，我们发现正交群中的乘积 A A'作用在 v 上，加上向量 A(b') + b 的平移。

column1: And so if I wanted to write down the product law of this times this in the group, it would equal the element (b + A(b'), A A').
column2: 因此如果我想在群中写出这个元素乘以那个元素的乘法法则，它就等于元素 (b + A(b'), A A')。

column1: That's what this product of these elements is in this group of motions. It's not a direct product group—if it were a direct product group, I'd have (b + b', A A').
column2: 这就是这些元素在运动群中的乘法。它不是直积群——如果是直积群，就会得到 (b + b', A A')。

column1: It's not quite a product group, so these things don't commute with each other.
column2: 它不完全是积群，因此这些元素彼此并不对易。

column1: But note that I do get a homomorphism to the orthogonal group, namely, if I now consider the map that takes me from a motion and it just remembers the orthogonal transformation—
column2: 但请注意，我的确得到了一个到正交群的同态，也就是说，如果我现在考虑从刚体运动出发、只保留其正交变换的映射——

column1: that takes a pair (b, A) to just the orthogonal transformation A, this is a surjective group homomorphism with kernel R^n. Namely, the kernel is the elements—all of the things of the form (b, I), the identity matrix.
column2: 把二元对 (b, A) 映为正交变换 A，这是一个满群同态，其核为 R^n。即核是由形如 (b, I) 的所有元素构成的，其中 I 为单位矩阵。

column1: Because when I take the product of two elements here and I just remember their orthogonal component, it's the product of the two matrices, so that part is a homomorphism.
column2: 因为当我在群里取两个元素的乘积并只保留其正交分量时，它就是这两个矩阵的乘积，所以那一部分是同态。

column1: And the kernel of that homomorphism is all the transformations that go to the identity matrix here, so those are just the translations.
column2: 而该同态的核是所有映到单位矩阵的变换，它们恰好就是平移。

column1: These have the property that when you act on v, you just get v + b; this is what we call T_b.
column2: 它们具有作用在 v 上只得到 v + b 的性质；这就是我们所说的 T_b。

column1: So the group is put together out of two groups, two subgroups: one is a normal subgroup, so this is a normal subgroup; and the other subgroup O(n) is isomorphic to the quotient group via this homomorphism.
column2: 因此这个群由两个群、两个子群拼合而成：一个是正规子群（平移子群是正规子群）；而另一个子群 O(n)通过这个同态同构于商群。

column1: So now the rest of the lecture is going to be on the situation when n is equal to 2, because that's an incredibly rich situation.
column2: 现在，本讲剩下的时间将集中讨论 n = 2 的情形，因为这是个极其丰富的情形。

column1: We're going to spend the next two lectures just looking at motions of the plane and what figures they preserve.
column2: 接下来的两讲我们将专门研究平面的刚体运动以及它们保持什么图形。

column1: This is the whole theory that was developed in ancient times of symmetry groups, and already for n = 2 it's a fascinating group, an incredibly rich group.
column2: 这是自古代发展起来的对称群的完整理论，并且仅仅在 n = 2 时，它就已经是一个迷人而异常丰富的群了。

column1: So what we did previously was we worked out what elements in O(2) look like. So for n = 2 we're talking about the group G which is R^2 semidirect O(2).
column2: 我们在之前的内容中已经推导了 O(2) 中的元素是什么样子。对于 n = 2，我们讨论的是群 G，即 R^2 与 O(2) 的半直积。

column1: So if the translation is trivial, O(2) is G_0, and we saw that that contained a subgroup SO(2) which was the rotations around the origin, and then there was a non-trivial coset of that which I'll call r_L, where the elements in this non-trivial coset all had order 2, and they were reflections across a line, a line through the origin.
column2: 如果平移是平凡的，O(2) 就是 G_0；我们看到它包含一个子群 SO(2)（即绕原点的旋转），此外还有一个非平凡陪集（我记作 r_L），其中的元素阶数全为 2，它们是关于某条直线的反射，一条过原点的直线。

column1: So that if one had a line that was through the origin, you took the perpendicular vector, you got a transformation that was +1 on this line, and where this was an eigenspace with eigenvalue -1, so that the general vector was just reflected across this line.
column2: 如果有一条过原点的直线，你取其垂直向量，就会得到在直线上特征值为 +1、而在法线上是特征值 -1 的特征空间的变换，使得一般向量正是关于这条直线反射。

column1: So if you had a vector v, it was taken to the vector—well, over here, the same distance here, this would be v, this would be r_L(v), where this was the line L.
column2: 所以如果你有一个向量v，它被映到向量——在这里，同样的距离，这是 v，这是 r_L(v)，其中L 是直线。

column1: So for every line through the origin, we had an orthogonal transformation of determinant -1, where the eigenvalues are +1 and -1, -1 on the orthogonal line; and the effect on a general vector is to reflect it across that line.
column2: 因此对过原点的每条直线，我们都有一个行列式为 -1 的正交变换，其特征值为 +1 和 -1，在正交直线上是 -1；它对一般向量的效果就是关于该直线作反射。

column1: And that was the non-trivial coset, where these were the rotations around the origin, and that we did last time.
column2: 这就是那个非平凡陪集，而另一部分则是绕原点的旋转，这是我们上次讲过的内容。
